To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a method to estimate RNA synthesis, degradation, and processing rates from a single metabolic labeling RNA sequencing sample can be used to reproduce previous results on the relationship between RNA dynamics and biological function, that it has several advantages over previous methods, and that it can be used in other contexts such the single cell setting.

1) we present a method to estimate RNA synthesis, degradation and processing rates from a single RNA-seq sample; 2) our method is computationally fast; 3) we demonstrate that our method is accurate and can reproduce results of previous studies; 4) we demonstrate that the method is useful to identify dynamic processes and estimate their responsiveness.

1) RNA synthesis, processing, and degradation rates can be estimated from a single RNA sequencing sample; 2) the method can be used to identify genes involved in dynamic biological processes; and 3) the method and theoretical analysis are general enough to apply to other contexts, such as single cell experiments.

the problem of estimating RNA processing and degradation parameters from single sample RNA sequencing data, and we present a novel and efficient method to achieve this.
